links.outcome: Prevalence of LLM use in work contexts among campus staff and students, ahead of governance
links.effect: Over 90% of respondents had heard of LLM tools and about two-thirds had used them in their work on campus; guidelines and governance are needed to keep up with practice.
links.quote: Our findings show LLM tools are already widely used on our campus.

screen.reason: Empirical survey assessing actual self-reported use, perceptions, and attitudes toward LLMs across a hospital/academic campus, demonstrating real-world adoption and need for governance.
